"Abhedya –Build. Defend. Break."

Get ready for the ultimate innovation challenge!

Shri Vaishnav Institute of Information Technology, a constituent of Shri Vaishnav Vidyapeeth Vishwavidyalaya, Indore (M.P.), proudly presents the 8th edition of “Void Hacks”, to be held on October 1–3, 2026 . Void Hacks () 8.0 welcomes students from Computer Science, Information Technology, and related disciplines at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels. Whether you’re a coder, designer, or tech innovator — this is your stage to create something extraordinary!

In collaboration with Indore Police, VOID HACKS 8.0 brings together young innovators, developers, and cybersecurity enthusiasts to tackle real-world challenges in cybersecurity, digital safety, and emerging technology. The collaboration aims to encourage innovative solutions and empower students to contribute towards a safer and more secure digital ecosystem.

What’s Void Hacks All About: Void Hacks is an offline national-level hackathon that brings together bright minds to ideate, innovate, and build impactful tech-driven solutions.

The hackathon will be conducted in two rounds:

  • Round 1 (Online): Teams will submit a PPT presentation based on the problem statement of given domain.   
    Note: It is compulsory to follow the 'idea_submission.pptx' template for PPT submission.
  • Round 2 (Offline Finale): Selected teams will be invited to SVVV, Indore, for an intensive 36 hour hackathon, where they’ll work on a new problem statement and present their final prototype.Domain & Prizes:This edition, all teams will compete in a single domain — *Cybersecurity* which will held from October 1-3 2026.
  • Winner- ₹50,000 
  • 2nd Runner-up-₹30,000
  • 3rd Runner-up- ₹20,000

  • Total Prize Pool: ₹1,00,000+

 

The Thrilling Part: Shortlisted teams will participate in a 36 hour offline hackathon filled with coding, collaboration, and innovation. It’s a one-of-a-kind opportunity to transform ideas into working prototypes under expert guidance and mentorship!

Team Size: For VOID HACKS 8.0, each team must consist of exactly 4 members, and all team members must belong to the same college/university. — so gather your squad, combine your skills, and get ready to innovate your way to the top!

Participation Certificate: Every registered participant will receive an official certificate of participation, recognizing their dedication and effort in Void Hacks () 8.0. Prepare for an unforgettable hackathon experience where creativity, collaboration, and technology come together. Void Hacks () 8.0 — where ideas meet innovation and hackers build the future!
